name: agentic-ai-regression
description: Fixed regression set for Mars. Gate cases run without an LLM and protect the Agentic AI domain lock and injection handling. Research cases are evaluated against saved report JSON files produced by a run; they assert structure, canonical tracks, evidence discipline and absence of leaked secrets. Change this file only in a reviewed commit and bump 'version'.

cases.notes: The default topic. A release must still produce a multi-track, cited report.

cases.notes: Protects the safety track and the untrusted-data protocol.
